notes.title: Dynamic Time Mode
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Dynamic time mode
[*] Significant visual improvements for Night time mode, particularly with lighting effects
[*] Powerups, explosions, weapon stores, mines, and sentry guns now emit light
[*] Added detail to the health bar (can be turned on / off in the settings menu)
[*] Various minor bug fixes
[/list]
Thanks for playing!
